results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: This news article details a study led by Professor Fabio Giglietto on Meta's political content reduction policy. Giglietto explains that Facebook's algorithm heavily suppressed the organic reach of mainstream democratically-elected Italian parliamentarians while failing to curb, and effectively boosting, the overall visibility of extremist, eurosceptic, and conspiratorial accounts.

results.title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
results.snippet: The article reports on the publication of a major study by Professor Fabio Giglietto analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts. It highlights his findings on the asymmetric impact of Meta's algorithmic policies, which penalized official institutional politics in Italy by cutting their reach while allowing far-right and extremist content to expand their footprint.
